name: Core HUD — Chat Bar
subtitle: OSRS UI composition reference vs Crafted Realms live browser HUD
review_note: The live chat now has a readable parchment body, dark beveled medieval frame, and the full All, Game, Public, Private, Clan, Trade, Yell, and Report channel row with status indicators.
improve: Future chat work should focus on multiplayer behavior and filtering rather than another visual rewrite.
